name: tadu-cloud-ai-agent
description: Tadu Cloud AI Agent Control Center Desktop Application

scripts.build:go:linux: cd tadu-go && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../dist/tadu-cloud-ai-agent . && cd ../server-go && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../dist/ai_agent_service . && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../dist/ai_agent_service_linux_amd64 . && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../dist/ai_agent_service_linux_arm64 .
scripts.build:go:win: cd tadu-go && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../dist/tadu-cloud-ai-agent.exe .
scripts.build:installer:linux: npm run build:go:linux && electron-builder --linux deb AppImage
scripts.build:all: npm run build:go:linux && npm run build:go:win && electron-builder --linux deb AppImage --win nsis

author: Tadu Cloud Team
